nextStoryContext: US-003 is complete. src/issues/select.ts provides two exports: selectPlannableIssue (pure, I/O-free: filters stage===specified+status===open+not blocked, sorts by rank asc then numeric-id suffix asc) and selectPlannableFromFile (thin async I/O seam: reads scripts/cam/issues.local.json via Bun.file + delegates to selectPlannableIssue). Test file test/issues/select.test.ts has 20 tests, all passing. The gate-as-code invariant is now implemented (D1 decision from ADR 0001). US-004 adopts the new schema in issue-file.ts and ship-finalize reader. US-006 rewrites cam-plan Step 2 to delegate to selectPlannableFromFile (three-copy sync: .claude/commands/cam-plan.md + templates/commands/cam-plan.md + src/vendor/_generated.ts). US-007 records Epico A in the ADR and patterns.md. Do NOT compute rank in select.ts (Epico C); only consume it if present.
